rationale: The design plan hinges on a second target message (1700200000.000457) that is not present in the base_seed messages array supplied with the case, while the assignment explicitly states base_seed is 'unchanged.' This means the compiled task's core referent set cannot be satisfied by the actual seed data — the solver would only ever find one genuine MCP-deployment question in #general, not the required two. The negative roles (engineering rewrite, DM, growth CDN question, general watch-party/captcha messages) are otherwise well-chosen and topically distinct, but they cannot compensate for the missing/fabricated positive referent that the obligation depends on.
